title: 第9章 竟然是真的碧落兰第10章 夏以苜被岳冉强行带走
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
林朔风持剑挡在夏以苜身前，寸步不移。
他开口道：“事已至此，验一验又有何妨？只是检验真假，不会耗费太多时间。”
“若那碧落兰是假的，我自愿领受和她一样的惩罚！”
此言一出，周围一片哗然。
那可是挖去灵根啊！林朔风竟没有半分犹豫！他那样高的天赋都舍得舍弃吗？！
岳冉脸色变了又变，好啊！林朔风想自寻死路，她倒是要看看他待会儿被挖灵根时，是否还能和现在一样面不改色。
“林朔风，你怎么变成这样了！”曹宗主皱着眉，一副痛心疾首的模样，“你从前那般明事理，如今怎的这般不辨是非？”
“这些年你们孤云峰上交宗门的灵植良莠不齐，可紫云宗还是看在你们师尊的面子上，对你们多有照拂，否则你们早被赶出宗了！”
“偏偏你们如今还如此帮着外人，罢了罢了，便依你所言，验上一验！”
“你也不必和她受一样的惩罚，之后搬离孤云峰便是。”
陆兜兜张大嘴巴，“孤云峰是师尊留给我们的！我们当真要搬离吗，大师兄？”
孤云峰上灵气充裕，很大一部分原因便是因为被他们师尊改造过。
之前紫云宗也施过压，要他们交出孤云峰，可想到那是师尊留下的，他们都抗住了。
如今，要为了一个夏以苜拱手让出吗？
林朔风想也没有想，便直接对着曹宗主回应，“好，我答应你。”
他对夏以苜很有自信，他知道，他姐种出来的东西不可能出问题。
“大师兄！”陆兜兜还想说什么，被陆萍萍踹了踹。
陆萍萍手里捧着碧落兰，只能动脚了，随后疯狂用眼神示意自家哥哥放心。
“你们两个，去验一验那碧落兰的真假。”曹宗主点了宗内无比权威的两名长老。
陆萍萍伸手便要将手里那株碧落兰送出去检验。

夏以苜却将她拦住，“说了那株是给你的，你好好收着便是。”
随即又从储物袋中掏出来了一株碧落兰。
储物袋是林朔风给她的。
众人：？？？
怎么还有？
先前林朔风那般态度，他们心里都有些动摇，觉得那碧落兰还有一两分的可能性是真的。
但此刻见夏以苜又掏出来一株，那一两分的可能性也没有了。
“这一株接一株的，真当碧落兰是大白菜啊？”
“我看她待会儿还要如何挽尊狡辩。”
几百年才出现一株的碧落兰，在夏以苜这里变成批发了，这谁敢信？
那边，夏以苜已经将碧落兰交到了那两名表情轻蔑的长老手中。
两名长老装模作样地检验着那株碧落兰，动作没有半分认真。
可随着检验的进行，两名长老忽然收敛了神色，动作也变得急切起来。
那边的曹宗主已经往后靠在椅背上，一副好整以暇的模样，只等着林朔风将孤云峰双手奉上。
没想到他最后是以这种方式拿到孤云峰。
虽然损失了一株碧落兰，但也不算太亏。
岳冉的目光则是落在了夏以苜的身上，等一切尘埃落定，她必定要这个凡人生不如死！
“如何，是不是真的？”夏以苜浅笑着，姿态闲适。
半分没有即将被挖去灵根的慌张。
content_en:
Lin Shuofeng held his sword in front of Xia Yilu, not moving an inch.
He said: "The matter has come to this, what's the harm in checking it? It's just checking the authenticity, it won't take too much time."
"If Biluolan is fake, I will willingly accept the same punishment as her!"
As soon as this statement came out, there was an uproar around him.
That's just digging out the spiritual roots! Lin Shuofeng didn't hesitate at all! Is he willing to give up such a high talent? !
Yue Ran's expression changed again and again, "Okay!" Lin Shuofeng wanted to seek death, but she wanted to see if he could remain as calm as now when his spiritual roots were dug out later.
"Lin Shuofeng, why have you become like this!" Sect Leader Cao frowned, looking distressed, "You were so sensible before, why are you so ignorant of right and wrong now?"
"The spiritual plants that you Guyun Peak have handed over to the sect over the years have been mixed, but the Ziyun Sect still takes care of you for the sake of your master, otherwise you would have been kicked out of the sect long ago!"
"Why are you still helping outsiders like this now? That's all. Let me put it to the test as you said!"
"You don't have to suffer the same punishment as her. You just need to move away from Guyun Peak."
Lu Doudou opened his mouth wide, "Guyun Peak was left to us by Master! Do we really want to move away, Senior Brother?"
There is abundant spiritual energy on Guyun Peak, and a large part of the reason is because it was transformed by their master.
The Ziyun Sect had also put pressure on them before to hand over Guyun Peak, but when they thought that it was left by their master, they resisted.
Now, do you want to give it up for Xia Yilu?
Without thinking, Lin Shuofeng responded directly to Sect Master Cao, "Okay, I promise you."
He was very confident in Xia Yilu. He knew that there would be no problem with what his sister grew.
"Elder brother!" Lu Doudou wanted to say something else, but was kicked by Lu Pingping.
Lu Pingping held Biluo Lan in her hands and could only move her feet. Then she frantically signaled her brother to feel relieved with her eyes.
"You two, go and test the authenticity of Biluolan." Sect Master Cao pointed to two elders with great authority in the sect.
Lu Pingping stretched out her hand to send the Biluolan in her hand for inspection.
However, Xia Yihuo stopped her and said, "I told you that the plant is for you, just keep it well."
Then he took out another blue orchid from the storage bag.
The storage bag was given to her by Lin Shuofeng.
Everyone:? ? ?
Why else?
Lin Shuofeng's previous attitude made them a little shaken, and they felt that there was still a possibility or two that Biluo Lan was real.
But now that Xia Yilu took out another one, the possibility of one or two points was gone.
"One after another, do you really think Biluolan is Chinese cabbage?"
"I'll see how she tries to defend herself later."
The Biluolan, which only appeared once every few hundred years, is wholesaled here in Xia Yiming. Who dares to believe this?
Over there, Xia Yihuo had already handed Biluo Lan into the hands of the two elders with contemptuous expressions.
The two elders pretended to examine the Biluolan without any seriousness in their actions.
But as the examination progressed, the two elders suddenly calmed down and their movements became urgent.
Over there, Sect Leader Cao had already leaned back on his chair, looking very rested, just waiting for Lin Shuofeng to offer Guyunfeng his hands.
Unexpectedly, he finally got Gu Yun Peak in this way.
Although one Biluolan was lost, it was not too bad.
Yue Ran's eyes fell on Xia Yilu. When everything settled, she would definitely make this mortal's life worse than death!
"What, is it true?" Xia Yihuo smiled lightly, with a relaxed posture.
There was no panic at all about being about to have his spiritual roots dug out.
